content.title: Pacers vs. Knicks: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/17/26)
content.text: The Indiana Pacers (15–53) face the New York Knicks (44–25) tonight at Madison Square Garden in New York. The Knicks extended their win streak to three games after a 110–107 victory over the shorthanded Golden State Warriors on Sunday, coming back from a 21-point deficit. Jalen Brunson led with 30 points and nine assists. Karl-Anthony Towns followed with a 17-point, 12-rebound double-double on an efficient 7-of-12 shooting. And OG Anunoby and Jordan Clarkson followed with 14 points apiece. Brunson is out for tonight’s game with an ankle injury. The Pacers, meanwhile, enter on a 13-game losing streak — one of several extended skids this season. Yet, despite their troubles, Indiana has remained competitive in all three games against the Knicks this season, even coming back to win in February at MSG in overtime. Last week’s 101–92 loss to New York in Indianapolis was also close, with Indiana cutting the deficit to two with less than three minutes left until the Knicks pulled away. With Pascal Siakam sidelined, Jarace Walker led Indiana with 18 points and nine boards. Aaron Nesmith followed with 12 and Ivica Zubac scored 11 in his second game with the Pacers. With Brunson out, Towns and New York’s inconsistent secondary scorers will need to step up against an Indiana team that has consistently punched above its weight against the Knicks and relishes the stage at MSG. Expect a double-digit Knicks win, but the Pacers should remain a nuisance for much of the game. Prediction: New York Knicks 114, Indiana Pacers 102 Injury Report New York Knicks Jalen Brunson — Out (Ankle) Miles McBride — Out (Pelvis) Indiana Pacers Micah Potter — GTD (Triceps) Obi Toppin — GTD (Foot) Ben Sheppard — GTD (Ankle) Quenton Jackson — GTD (Calf) T.J.
